import sys

kmers={}

    kmers[p[0]]=(p[1][0],p[1][1])
def nxt(k,c): return k[1:]+c
def prv(k,c): return c+k[:-1]
out=[l.strip() for l in open('/app/serial.out') if l.strip()]

    for i in range(len(s)-K+1):

        if km not in kmers: print("UNKNOWN KMER",km); bad+=1; break

        if i>0:
            c=s[i-1]
            if L=='F': print("LEFT EXT F but has left",km); bad+=1;break
            if km[i-1:i-1+K] if False else s[i-1:i-1+K] != prv(km,c): pass
            if prv(km,c) not in kmers: print("missing predecessor",km,c);bad+=1;break
        if i+K<len(s):
            c=s[i+K]
            if R=='F': print("RIGHT EXT F but has right",km);bad+=1;break
            if nxt(km,c) not in kmers: print("missing successor",km,c);bad+=1;break
print("contigs:",len(out),"bad:",bad)
# 2. coverage: every kmer covered
cov=set()
for s in out:
    for i in range(len(s)-K+1): cov.add(s[i:i+K])
print("covered:",len(cov),"of",len(kmers))
# 3. maximality: no contig can be extended right

    if R!='F' and nxt(last,R) in kmers:

print("non-maximal right:",nonmax)
EOF
